tspan.tspan: 户外远景天空云层与群山

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 需要为 3D 场景中的光滑地面、玻璃或金属提供环境反射 (IBL Specular)?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 反射环境是户外无穷远天空，还是有边界的室内房间/车库/街道?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 使用标准无穷远天空盒采样: textureCube(envMap, R)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 如何构造立方体贴图的采样方向向量?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: ❌ 严重视差打滑! 离墙 2m 处采样到 7.0m 高处 (+5.0m 错位)，倒影随视角溜冰

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: ✅ 精准锚定墙面 Y=2.0000m (0 滑移) · 墙根倒影严丝合缝且提速 28.79×
